  • Constructor Details

    • SignalEvidence

      public SignalEvidence(String logicalTag, String value, String engineeringUnit, long timestampMillis, ControllerEvidenceBinding.EvidenceQuality quality, String provenanceId)
      Creates signal evidence.
      Parameters:
      logicalTag - public logical signal name, not a private source-system tag
      value - source value represented as text
      engineeringUnit - source engineering unit or state/count qualifier
      timestampMillis - source timestamp in epoch milliseconds
      quality - source quality state
      provenanceId - opaque document, dataset, or retrieval-record identifier; never a credential
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if logicalTag is null or empty
